title: CardCorpus set
description: One set: its releases, description, tell, print runs, versions and links, and every card with its copies, and its sealed products.

id.description: The set's id. Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

catalog.description: The catalog the set belongs to.

era.description: Its era, by pointer, which stays when the era is renamed.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `era`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

type.description: What the set is, by how its cards reached people.

language.description: The language its cards are printed in: its releases' (a French McDonald's set is international but French).

position.description: Its place among its catalog's sets of one release date, where the data orders them.

line.description: The line the set is one part of, where several of our sets came out as one product or range of products (docs/static-api.md, "Lines").

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `line`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

part.description: The words that tell this set from the line's others.

printedTotal.description: The total its card numbers print (the 102 of 4/102), where they print one.

actualTotal.description: How many cards the set has by its own count, secret cards included, where known.

cardCount.description: How many cards the set has in its `cards`; always present, 0 included.

productCount.description: How many sealed products the set has in its `products`; always present, 0 included.

released.description: When the set first (its earliest release) came out, as precisely as is known (docs/static-api.md, "Release dates").

code.description: The set code it prints: the first of its releases' that has one.

logo.description: Its logo: the first of its releases' that has one.

symbol.description: Its set symbol: the first of its releases' that has one.

releases.description: Each release of the set: one per language it came out in.

language.description: The language this release is printed in.

name.description: The set's name in this release.

released.description: When this release came out, as precisely as is known (docs/static-api.md, "Release dates").

symbol.description: The set symbol, the small mark its cards print (an icon a source gives for a set that prints none).

linkCount.description: How many links the set has to other sets; always present, 0 included.

description.description: What we wrote about the set, for people to read, and the pages it draws on (docs/static-api.md, "Descriptions").

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

tell.description: How to tell this set's print of a card from other sets' prints of the same painting, in a few words, naming only what every card of the set prints (its symbol, its numbering), with the pages that back it; a card's own `tell` stands in for it (docs/static-api.md, "Set tells").

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

printRuns.description: The set's print runs whose place is known, earliest first, by edition (`unlimited` also stands for copies with no edition), each with what we say of it (docs/static-api.md, "Print runs").

released.description: When the run first came out, as precisely as is known (docs/static-api.md, "Release dates").

tell.description: How to spot it, in a few words.

standard.description: Present where the run's copies are the set's standard ones and that isn't Unlimited (a Japanese booster set's 1st Edition).

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

versions.description: The versions the set's product was sold in, earliest first, where the version decides some of the cards in it (pack designs of a set sold in waves, binders of two colours); a card found in only some names them in its own `onlyIn` (docs/static-api.md, "Versions").

id.description: The set version's id, unique in its set's `versions`.

released.description: When the version came out, as precisely as is known (docs/static-api.md, "Release dates").

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

distributions.description: How every copy of the set was handed out, where all came out one way (a Prize Pack series, a Burger King collection), named once here and not on each copy (docs/static-api.md, "Distributions").

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `distribution`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

category.description: A copy of the target's own `category`.

as.description: How the copy came out of a distribution that also handed out others: as a `prize` or to `staff`.

region.description: Where it was handed out, where only in some places.

backImage.description: The back every card of the set shares, where that is unlike the usual one (a World Championships Deck's).

links.description: The set's links to other sets.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

relation.description: What the other set is to this one.

direction.description: Which way the link reads: `outgoing` from this set to the other, or `incoming` from the other to this one.

sameCardCount.description: How many of the two sets' cards are linked as the same card; always present, 0 included.

products.description: Every sealed product, in number order.

id.description: The card's id, unique in its set. Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

displayName.description: A numberless card's name with its versions, where another card of the set's versions shares its name: "Pikachu (blue)" (docs/static-api.md, "Versions").

number.description: Its number as printed ("4/102", "SWSH001"), and the part of it a sort reads.

printed.description: The number as printed, where the card prints one.

numerator.description: The part of the number a sort reads.

rarity.description: Its rarity, as its mark reads (docs/rarity.md).

cardType.description: Pokémon, Trainer or Energy; a sealed product has none.

language.description: The language its text is printed in: its set's, or another where its product held a foreign print (docs/static-api.md, "Foreign prints"). Every card has one; a sealed product has none.

credit.description: The credit as printed ("CR CG gangs & K. Hoshiba").

artists.description: The people the credit names, in credit order, each by pointer with the name as this card prints it; a director's credit names no one.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `artist`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

name.description: The artist's name as this card prints it.

released.description: When the card first came out, in any of its copies: its own date, or, in a set whose cards came out together, the set's (docs/static-api.md, "Release dates").

date.description: The date, as precisely as is known: 2001, 2001-09 or 2001-09-22; absent where neither the card's nor the set's is known.

sort.description: Sorts cards oldest first, every list alike: compare as plain strings. An ordering convention, not a date; every card has one.

sources.description: The pages the card's own date comes from; absent when it has the set's.

site.description: The site, as the title names it before the page ("Pokumon: Base Set" is Pokumon).

description.description: What we wrote about the card, for people to read, and the pages it draws on (docs/static-api.md, "Descriptions").

text.description: The text; paragraphs are split by a blank line.

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

tell.description: How to tell this card's print where it differs from its set's `tell`.

text.description: The tell; null where the card doesn't carry the set's tell (a basic Energy with no set mark).

sources.description: The pages this draws on, each with its title.

eReaderLayout.description: Where it prints its e-Reader strip, as its pictures show: `e_card` (along the bottom, under the number, and down the left edge, as Expedition to Skyridge do) or `ex` (one strip along the bottom, under the weakness row, as the EX sets do). Absent where it prints none or nobody has looked (docs/static-api.md, "e-Reader strip").

species.description: The species it shows, each once, in the order the card shows them.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `species`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

subjects.description: Who is on the card: its owner, its Pokémon (a form of a species), then people, each a `subject` or `owner`.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `form` or `character`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

species.description: The form's species' National Pokédex number, on a `form`.

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

role.description: What they are on the card: its `subject`, or the `owner` of its Pokémon.

inSet.description: What it is among its set's cards (docs/static-api.md, "Telling copies apart").

differs.description: Its default copy's axes that not all the set's other prints of its painting share.

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

printVersion.description: Which of a name's numberless prints it is.

onlyIn.description: The set's versions it comes in, where it isn't in all of them.

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `set-version`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (docs/static-api.md, "Pointers").

version.description: The set version's id, unique in its set's `versions`.

pieces.description: For one piece of a LEGEND or V-UNION, the whole card's pieces (docs/static-api.md, "Pieces").

format.description: What kind of card in pieces it is.

position.description: This piece's position, counted from 1 in vocabulary.json's `positions` for the format.

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set.

picture.description: The picture to show for the card (docs/static-api.md, "Pictures"): `front.image`, and `front.of`, the copy it is a picture of (its default copy, another copy standing in, or, for a reprint with no picture of any copy, its original's); `back`, where its back is unlike the usual one; `oversized` where the card only came as a jumbo or its picture is a jumbo copy's.

front.description: The front: a picture id, and whose picture it is.

of.description: The copy it is a picture of, where that isn't the copy it is on (on a card, always).

card.description: The card's id, unique in its set. Present on a `variant`.

product.description: The sealed product's id, unique in its set. Present on a `product-variant`.

variant.description: The copy's id, unique among its card's (or product's) variants.

watermark.description: Whose watermark the picture carries, where it carries one.

back.description: Its back, where that is unlike the usual one.

oversized.description: Present where the card only came as a jumbo or its picture is a jumbo copy's.

variants.description: Its copies, in role order; the standard one, or the first on a test-only card, supplies the card picture.

id.description: The copy's id, unique within its card: its physical axes as a slug, or "plain". Treat it as opaque: it never changes once published.

collectingVariation.description: The id in this card's collectingVariations for this exact copy with its print run left unspecified. All its non-edition distinctions remain known.

name.description: What the card's copy strip calls it (docs/static-api.md, "Telling copies apart").

role.description: What this copy is on its card; copies are listed in role order (docs/static-api.md, "Version roles").

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

serialCodeVariantOf.description: Another code of the same physical version, by its pointer.

product.description: The sealed product's id, unique in its set. Present on a `product-variant`.

variant.description: The copy's id, unique among its card's (or product's) variants.

eReaderStrip.description: What it prints where its card prints the e-Reader strip (the card's `eReaderLayout`), as its own picture shows: the dot code, holo bars in its place (a reverse holo, a holo rare), or nothing (`blank`: an EX card without a strip). Absent where nobody has looked (docs/static-api.md, "e-Reader strip").

editionMark.description: The edition mark it prints: `first_edition`, the 1st Edition symbol. Its edition's mark (vocabulary `edition`, `mark`) unless the copy says otherwise, as Base Set Machamp's stamped ©1999-2000 4th print does. Absent where it prints none (docs/static-api.md, "Edition mark").

printRun.description: The edition of the set's print run (its `printRuns`) the copy came out in, where the set lists that run (docs/static-api.md, "Telling copies apart").

differsFromStandard.description: Its axes that the card's standard copy doesn't share (all of them on a card with no standard copy); none on the standard copy.

material.description: What it is printed on, where that isn't ordinary card.

tell.description: How to spot it on the card, in a sentence or two.

picture.description: The copy's picture (docs/static-api.md, "Pictures"): its own, or, with `front.of`, another copy's standing in for one it lacks (the standard copy's; on the standard copy, the first other copy's); and its back, where that is unlike the usual one.

front.description: The front: a picture id, and whose picture it is.

of.description: The copy it is a picture of, where that isn't the copy it is on (on a card, always).

name.description: The compiler-labelled variation, including its known finish; no edition is implied.

defaultCopy.description: An exact member to use for a picture or clearly labelled reference price only; it is never an implied owned print run.

masterSet.description: Present where the variation is in the master set: one of its copies is the card's standard copy or a parallel of it, not only another print run, a serial code, a special release, an error, a test print or an oversized copy.

defaultCollectingVariation.description: The collectingVariations id of defaultCopy. Quick Collect saves it, with defaultCollectingCopy where that is present.

defaultCollectingCopy.description: Present where defaultCollectingVariation has more than one print run: defaultCopy, which quick Collect saves with it, as the copy on show is the one meant (Base Set Charizard's Unlimited).
